latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Luma Video Generation skill.

- Generate AI videos via AceDataCloud Luma Dream Machine API.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video extension from existing clips.
- Includes authentication, detailed parameter options, and aspect ratio presets.
- Provides example workflows and quick start instructions.
- Environment variable ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN required for use.
